text: Joanna wrote a script about self-discovery and met movie producers, who responded enthusiastically. She found childhood notebooks; her favorite was a story aged 10 about a brave turtle, reflecting courage and risk. Nate helps friends reset international video game tournament high scores. Joanna, lactose-intolerant, will visit Nate tomorrow; he made coconut-milk dessert. She'll bring recipes, including chocolate-raspberry cake.
